calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.business_date) AS days
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct, ty.days, ly.days AS ly_days
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27'
ORDER BY 2

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.net_sales<>0 THEN r.store_id END) AS stores_active, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' OR d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
  AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.calendar_date

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS ctrl_total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END),2) AS ctrl_physical, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END),2) AS ctrl_web,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM rpt_daily_store_sales x WHERE x.business_date BETWEEN MIN(d.calendar_date) AND MAX(d.calendar_date) AND x.store_id>=900) AS hi_stores
FROM dim_date d JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2

SELECT 'closure' AS k, store_id, closure_type, closure_start_date, closure_end_date, weeks_closed FROM ref_store_closure WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', store_id, store_name || ' ' || coalesce(format,'') || ' ' || is_current, open_date, close_date, NULL FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND (close_date IS NOT NULL OR open_date >= DATE '2024-01-01')

calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS mn, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND (sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), NULL, NULL FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_order', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-20' AND DATE '2025-06-25' OR CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-01'

SELECT o.status, s.store_id=900 AS is_web_store, COUNT(*) AS lines, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-30' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05') AND (s.store_id=900 OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT r.store_id, (SELECT max(store_name) FROM dim_store x WHERE x.store_id=r.store_id) AS store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS net
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id IN (125,129) AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 8
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3 DESC,4

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_period = 2
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
